purpose: Independent reasoning fixtures. Apply preparation to each case separately; assess choices and downstream behavior, not prompt phrases.

cases.description: PR #330 fixes HTML encoding of literal tag delimiters in the title encoder.
cases.agreement: User: encoding of literal input only; decoding escaped Unicode and entities is explicitly excluded from this PR.
cases.feedback: A reviewer demonstrates that decoding an entity before rendering could expose a delimiter and requests a general decoder.

repository.tests/test_title_encoding.py: Existing literal delimiter, ordinary Unicode, and already-encoded string cases.

cases.task: Choose validity and scope disposition independently, remedy depth, placement and sufficient tests.

cases.description: The PR description promises safe rendering for all attacker-controlled strings, while the proposed code escapes literal delimiters only.
cases.agreement: No explicit exclusion or precedence resolves whether encoded representations are supported.
cases.feedback: The issue repeats the all-input safety guarantee; an inline comment proposes treating encoded representations as unsupported.
cases.task: State whether work can proceed, conflicting statements, viable options and dependent work. Do not invent an exclusion.

cases.description: Fix normalize_name to preserve an internal hyphen while stripping trailing whitespace.

repository.tests/unit/test_names.py: Existing table-driven normalize_name tests and shared name fixture.

cases.description: Fix a launcher that incorrectly passes the inherited LANG instead of the explicitly configured child locale.
cases.agreement: The configured locale must reach the actual child. Preserve other inherited environment values.

repository.src/launcher.py: build_env is passed to subprocess.run; the call currently drops env=build_env(config).
repository.tests/unit/test_launcher.py: build_env is tested directly; subprocess.run is replaced with a mock returning success.
repository.tests/integration/test_launcher.py: Existing fixture creates an executable in a temporary directory and invokes launch with a controlled PATH.

cases.task: Identify exactly what existing units fail to prove and how to cover the missing contract without live services.

cases.description: Refactor launcher environment merging without changing the documented child locale contract.
cases.agreement: Configured LANG wins; unrelated inherited keys remain.

repository.src/launcher.py: Merge logic moves within the existing launcher module.
repository.tests/integration/test_launcher.py: A real child writes LANG and an unrelated inherited sentinel to JSON. Test asserts configured LANG and preserved sentinel with conflicting parent LANG.

cases.task: Decide whether additional integration coverage is needed; state sufficient evidence and remaining limitations.

cases.description: A payload normalization fix copies the same field mapping into CLI, HTTP and batch entrypoints.
cases.agreement: All adapters consume the same domain payload contract; no public interface or dependency-direction change is intended.

cases.description: Two separate changes: optimize a monthly admin report; fix unbounded allocation in the release import path.
cases.agreement: Admin report has no latency/resource SLO. Release import must stay below 64 MiB peak memory for the documented 100k-record workload; that limit is a release criterion.

repository.src/admin/report.py: Cold monthly path, no observed operational failure.
repository.src/importer.py: Materializes every decoded record before processing.
repository.tests/performance/test_importer.py: Existing subprocess peak-memory measurement fixture for documented workloads.

cases.task: Treat each change independently: decide actionability, dedicated performance review and measurements.

cases.agreement: User explicitly permits removing legacy in v2 and explicitly requires client_id for all supported v2 clients.
cases.feedback: Reviewer A demands a compatibility shim for legacy; reviewer B reproduces missing client_id in a supported v2 response.
